verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an API platform with embeddable SDKs and widgets like MX, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting to disable telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking in MX's SDKs, Connect Widget, Client Dashboard, or API. Mobile maintenance mode and user lookup are unrelated controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
